# omada_vlan (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Omada VLAN by ID, name, or IEEE 802.1Q VLAN ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_vlan" "iot" {
  vlan_id = 20
}

output "iot_network_id" {
  value = data.omada_vlan.iot.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Omada network ID lookup selector and result.
- `name` (String) VLAN name lookup selector and result.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN ID lookup selector and result.

### Read-Only

- `device_mac` (String) MAC address of the gateway owning the VLAN.
- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateway DHCP server is enabled.
- `dhcp_range_end` (String) Last DHCP pool address, when present.
- `dhcp_range_start` (String) First DHCP pool address, when present.
- `gateway_subnet` (String) Gateway address and CIDR.
- `isolation` (Boolean) Whether inter-VLAN isolation is enabled.
- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the site's primary LAN.
